title: finding(types): 27 published `.describe()` schema descriptions in `packages/types/src/zod/**` cite source line addresses — the authorable surface carries a citation nothing reads
body:
Filed by the objectui#8047 dev seat (`domain:devx` lane) as the disposition of a reading handed forward on objectui#8045 (comment 5574…, the MERGED note): *"16 处 `.describe()` 散文里的源码地址 … 交由 #8047 的裁量决定纳入其范围还是另立兄弟卡"*. This is that decision, and the decision is **out of scope for objectui#8047** — filed here instead of ridden on that card.

## Why it is not objectui#8047's

objectui#8047 delivered `object-ui/no-line-address-in-test-name`, an ESLint rule over **test names**. Its population property is *"nothing reads a test name, so the citation cannot fail."* A `.describe()` argument is a different surface with a different property:

- it is a **published Zod schema description**, so it reaches the authorable surface (tooling, docs, editor hints) rather than a test report;
- editing it is a **contract-adjacent** act, not a test rename — which is exactly the reason the objectui#8045 seat declined to touch these and passed the reading on;
- the standing ruling it would be judged against (objectui#7853, *cite the assertion by CONTENT, not by line address*) is about assertions, and these are not assertions.

⇒ The rule shipped for objectui#8047 deliberately does **not** report them, and this card is the honest home for the reading rather than a silent widening of that rule.

## Re-measured today, not carried forward

The figure on objectui#8045 was **16** in four files, taken 2026-09-07. Re-taken on `origin/main` at `868e82501` — a `.describe()` string argument holding a `NAME.ext:NNN` address, counted per address:

| file | addresses |
|---|---|
| `packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts` | 8 |
| `packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts` | 8 |
| `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts` | 6 |
| `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts` | 3 |
| `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` | 1 |
| `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts` | 1 |
| **total** | **27** |

⚠️ **27, not 16.** The two files that grew the count — `overlay.zod.ts` and `data-display.zod.ts` — were the ones objectui#8045's dev correctly refused to touch because parked PRs objectui#8354 / objectui#8405 held them; those have since landed, and the addresses landed with them. ⛔ Do not carry the 16 forward.

Control for the reading, in the same run: the same matcher over **every** string in `packages/types` returns **194** addresses, so the 27 is a filtered subset of a non-empty total and not a broken matcher reporting a confident zero.

## What is NOT claimed here

- ⛔ Not claimed that any of the 27 is currently **wrong**. Nobody has checked them, which is the point: nothing opens the cited file, so an inaccurate one and an accurate one are indistinguishable from inside the repository.
- ⛔ Not claimed that they should all be deleted. Some may be worth keeping as prose with the address removed; some may belong in a code comment beside the schema rather than in the published description at all. That is the decision this card asks for.
- ⛔ No `domain:*` label applied — routing belongs to triage, and this seat does not produce one.

Refs: objectui#7853 (the standing ruling) · objectui#8045 (where the reading was taken and parked) · objectui#8047 (the test-name rule that scopes this out).

Raised by Claude Code on behalf of the `domain:devx` @ objectui execution seat, PM session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, round R46.
